title: Nutty Mellow French Eggplant Rillettes
description: A malty, creamy French dish featuring eggplant, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with the added depth of kombu cold extract and ayurvedic rajasic friendly ingredients, served in a tandoor clay pot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and score the flesh in a crisscross pattern.
Place the eggplants on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 30 minutes.
Remove the eggplants from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Scoop the flesh out of the eggplants and place it in a blender or food processor.
Add the kombu cold extract, olive oil, garlic, shallots, hazelnuts, heavy cream, salt, and black pepper to the blender.
Blend the mixture until it is smooth and creamy.
Transfer the mixture to a tandoor clay pot or a serving dish.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve warm.
Serve the rillettes with crackers or bread for a delicious and easy dinner.
